claude-cli.escalation: The pod has recovered, so there is nothing to patch. The frontend pod is Running and Ready, and the api Service has 1 ready endpoint. Probes have returned 200 continuously since the last restart at 19:29:31. Argo CD shows the app as Synced.
claude-cli.root_cause: The container's last termination (exit 1, 19:29:07) came from a startup race. nginx failed with "host not found in upstream 'api'" because the api Service was not yet resolvable in DNS when the frontend started. Kubernetes restarted the container, and it has been healthy since the 3rd restart. The upstream name 'api' in the frontend-nginx ConfigMap is correct. The latest api.yaml commits (93e5c37, 3ab538b, 20:24-20:25) came after this crash, so they did not cause it. A durable hardening would be a startup-order tolerance, such as a resolver directive with a variable upstream. That is a design change and not supported by evidence of a current fault.
